_doc: The list of 2026-11-14 (docs/improvements13.txt): the biomes' scenery. 926 scenery writes 'pieces' into brokenspire's WildPieces as n13_<name>#<n> and 'kinds' into WildSceneryKinds (FRDWildSceneryKind: a structure's fields plus place, uses, hazards, herd, ambush_r); 'fx' into WildSceneryFx as f13_<name>; 'channels' into WildChannelRules (the dry channels the world cuts, FRDWildWorld::MakeChannels); 'storm' the far storms over the open lands. The world places a kind in most cells of a 600 m grid of its biomes (FRDWildWorld::SceneryIn), a chunk lays it by the ruins' layout language (RD/RDWildRuin12.cpp: its parts; fx=<name> an effect at the layout's points, hours= day|night|dusk; inst=1 many as instances (patches); far=1 never culled (a landmark); L=mound|cone|ridge a rise of the land); RD/RDWildScenery13.cpp runs its uses (do=loot|forage|fish|honey|lore|heal|buff|fairy|milestone|rumour|climb|tracks), hazards (kind=collapse|sting|lurker) and herd (fauna:count;migrate;stampede;pen). A kind's front (its frame's +X) faces the road for place 'road', the meeting for 'crossroads', the water for a kind with need_water. Kit pieces (SM_N13_*) are blender_numpy/scenery13_kit.py's (926 kit).

kinds.name: tall_grass
